p.b: This code system defines the following properties for its concepts

tr.td: Device category (spacecraft, life-support, suit, medical-equipment, habitat, isru-system, power-generation, rover)
Primary test environment (ground, orbital-test, analog-mission, mars-surface)

div.p: This case-sensitive code system https://awatson1978.github.io/aerospace-medicine-ig/CodeSystem/mars-prototype-devices-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: Fully reusable rocket/lander for Mars (prototype stage, orbital tests ongoing 2020s)
Pressurized living quarters for Mars surface (NASA DRA 5.0 concept, no full prototype yet)
Next-generation planetary EVA suit under development for lunar and Mars surface EVAs
Scaled-up MOXIE + Sabatier system to produce CH4/O2 on Mars (tested at prototype level, MOXIE on Perseverance for O2)
10 kW nuclear fission surface power unit (prototyped on Earth 2018, KRUSTY demo, for future Mars use)
Concept vehicle for long-range crew excursions (prototypes like NASA SEV exist but not Mars-certified)
Concept medical device for Mars (lightweight operating table, robotic assist tools, TRL<6 prototype)

description.value: Developmental or conceptual hardware for Mars missions (prototypes, test articles, planned systems)
